scope: Strict architecture-and-mechanism superiority over every mandatory named commercial baseline, independently of proprietary legal-content volume or exclusivity.
formal_rule: For every b in B_COMM and every a in A_BIND: StrictBetter_a(E_star,b). Also Capabilities(b) is a proper subset of Capabilities(E_star) under universal trace/capability refinement.

strict_better.quantitative: After result-blind calibration, the conservative lower bound for E_star must exceed the conservative upper bound for baseline b by at least epsilon_a, where epsilon_a is derived before measurement from instrument resolution and reproducibility error. Equality, interval overlap or a post-hoc epsilon fails.
strict_better.qualitative: The frozen typed evidence lattice for axis a must mechanically prove rank_a(E_star) strictly above rank_a(b). Equality, incomparability and assessor preference fail.
strict_better.logical: E_star proves a strictly stronger property over a domain that contains the baseline property domain; a smaller domain, stronger assumptions or a shifted boundary fails.
strict_better.capability: Every reachable baseline capability and trace is refined by E_star and at least one material property of that same capability is strictly improved; the complete E_star capability set is a proper superset.
strict_better.absolute_ceiling: If a baseline is already at a proved absolute ceiling on any binding axis, strict improvement is impossible and T6 remains BLOCKED. Equality at the ceiling is not renamed superiority.

binding_axes.name: legal-reasoning correctness and defeater sensitivity
multi-step task decomposition and plan completeness
agent coordination, dependency control, parallelism and arbitration
source-selection and grounding mechanism independent of corpus size
citation and legal-authority validation mechanism
evidence provenance and transformation-lineage completeness
matter context, institutional memory and reflective-memory semantics
temporal and legal-state consistency
contradiction, uncertainty, coverage and blind-spot handling
self-falsification, counter-design generation and escalation
workflow and tool orchestration with explicit transaction semantics
institutional decision authority, review and accountable state transition
auditability, provenance-complete replay and reproducibility
determinism under frozen inputs and declared nondeterminism control
durability, crash consistency and bounded recovery
progress and liveness under the declared operating model
latency across frozen workload distributions
throughput, scale and resource-normalized performance
introspection, explanation and inspectable causal account
evolvability with monotonic capability and invariant preservation
formal assurance and architecture-to-source-to-executable property transport
mechanism generality across legal orders without content-specific redesign

axis_closure.rule: The registry is complete only when every material mechanism property discovered in B0, every mandatory commercial baseline, current primary-source research and red-team synthesis maps to one axis or is mechanically proved irrelevant. Discovery of an unmapped material property opens a new preserved axis epoch and forces full replay.

evaluation_tracks.mechanism_normalized: Use common public or synthetic material, frozen task families, result-blind calibration and an explicitly normalized model/tool envelope. Report model and tool dependence instead of attributing it to architecture.
evaluation_tracks.actual_product_black_box: Evaluate the actual named service on identical externally observable tasks and inputs. Preserve full prompts, outputs, citations, timings, versions and environment. Product access or comparison gaps remain UNKNOWN.
evaluation_tracks.architecture_class_proof: Map every behaviorally distinguishable baseline mechanism into the sealed architecture grammar and prove class coverage or a stronger upper bound. Public marketing claims and finite benchmarks alone cannot prove T6.

capability_proper_superset.rule: For every mandatory baseline b, Dom(b) is a subset of Dom(E_star), every reachable observable capability/trace of b is refined by E_star, each mapped capability is materially improved, and E_star has at least one additional material capability not present in b.

phase_2_limit: Phase 2 must design for, inventory and challenge this rule, but cannot discharge FOC-18 or prove T6. It submits the baseline ledger, complete 66-cell planned matrix and mechanism-only evaluation plan for independent review.
